title: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 7, 2026, announcing that its CyPath Lung test will be presented at the Cleveland Clinic's invitation-only 'Advances in Early Lung Cancer Detection' symposium on April 16, 2026. The filing is a routine SEC disclosure for an emerging growth company listed on Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker BIAF.

The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K filing.
